svg.title: The Intelligence Radar
svg.desc: 9 dimension segments; rings Use, Trial, Evaluate and Wait from the centre, and Prepare as the outer ring; 108 numbered entries, 14 of them in Prepare. Colour shows the dimension; the small badge shows the enterprise label: R Revisit, T Test, P Plan for, W Watch.
